notes.title: Last Operation DLC is already available!
notes.content:
Last Operation
The Last Operation story add-on is now available for download as an update! A new story, characters, locations, game situations and musical compositions await you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429628/0bfefa3d6baa0169c885579e6073f155f19e4814.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429628/00640b4dfa1d2743f7c0abc790438a6815a5bfb4.jpg
Reviews, bugs & errors
I will be glad if after finishing your playthrough you leave a review and share your impressions. If during the game you find any bugs or errors, then please write here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2526210/discussions/0/4030221396678471518/


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429628/66536bbac36b7be83b630d3c178b8bd6f6002c5d.jpg
Story of Bion
The main campaign also received a large number of fixes!
What was fixed:

a bug due to which bullets sometimes flew through enemies without damaging them;
a bug with a black screen that appeared after loading a save;
a bug due to which killed enemies continued to follow the player;
a bug with music that played during a pause;
and other minor fixes.

Thank you for waiting and have a pleasant playthrough!

notes.title: Announcement of a FREE DLC for Hope of Bion
notes.content:
Afterlife is a FREE DLC for Hope Of Bion consisting of three new standalone campaigns that take place in parallel to the events of the main story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429628/206036021a1d20bd77e0cd4384632b5600df11d3.jpg
Last Operation
Kyle together with his squad finds himself locked inside of the city hospital and now has to survive by fighting crowds of infected, but the hero soon realizes that it’s not a normal hospital and it has something hidden inside of it...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429628/be805f9bd825e57bf2d94d99dfb4f29481f7c86e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429628/bead25c7ef0d8f9fe68ab00ac4ecc3524d96b0d8.jpg
Dying School
The group of teenagers plans to escape from school and stay alive, but to do that they have to forget old grudges and start working in cooperation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429628/85aab05b08ce51fcba1f1ed156e96b9515eae8e3.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429628/c281185f1f5e125ffea4102e7c470e14407c0179.jpg
Hope of The Universe
Sequel to that game about a red robot – Heaventron. The universe is in danger and only our mechanized hero can save it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429628/9705b68b84988e3be5ce7c6f20ae8bd27772103a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429628/2286f2715a2a032463cd1bbaece8a1e819011ea2.jpg
Features:

New plot lines, characters, enemies, weapons, locations, puzzles and game situations;
New soundtrack, in addition to the acoustic guitar, other musical instruments will also be used;
Each campaign takes about 1 hour to complete, in total: 3 hours of new content. For comparison, the main game takes 2-3 hours to complete;
DLC will be fully FREE and its release will in no way influence the basic price of the game.

The first campaign will release in the beginning of November, the remaining two will release in 2025.
